Adjacent emphasis elements share one delimiter run

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p><i>A</i><i>B</i><i>C</i></p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
